Railway Recruitment 2026 — 4,651 Act Apprentice posts in Northern Railway!

RRC Northern Railway has started online applications for 4,651 Act Apprentice posts from 11 November 2026. Eligibility: 10th pass with at least 50% marks + ITI. NO EXAM — selection is purely on merit of 10th + ITI marks. Application fee is only Rs.100. Last date to apply: 11 December 2026.

Apply only on the official website: https://rrcnr.org
Official Notification PDF: https://rrcnr.org/downloads/Notification_Act_Appretice_2026.pdf
